features.name: Combat Aptitude
features.description: When you choose the College of Skalds at 3rd level, you become proficient in all martial weapons, as well as in the use of medium armor and shields.

features.name: Saga of Deeds
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, the dice gained from your Bardic Inspiration feature can be used in the following ways:

* After rolling damage for a successful weapon attack, a creature can roll a Bardic Inspiration die and add the result to the damage.
* When a creature is the target of an attack roll, before knowing the result, it may roll a Bardic Inspiration die as a reaction and add the result to its AC for that specific attack only.

features.name: Battle Fury
features.description: At 6th level, when you use the attack action, you can make two attacks instead of one.

features.name: Song and Strike
features.description: Starting at 14th level, any time you cast a bard spell as an action, you can use your bonus action to make a single weapon attack.
